newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA PUT SOUTH AFRICA IN TO BAT IN ONE-DAY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA PUT SOUTH AFRICA IN TO BAT IN ONE-DAY MATCH.

text.p: Australia won the toss and asked South Africa to bat in their seventh and final one-day international cricket match on Sunday.
South Africa - Lance Klusener, Herschelle Gibbs, Hansie Cronje (captain), Daryll Cullinan, Jacques Kallis, Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Derek Crookes, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Allan Donald.
Australia - Mark Waugh, Michael Di Venuto, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh (captain), Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Adam Gilchrist, Brendon Julian, Paul Reiffel, Andrew Bichel, Adam Dale.
